Refs #

## Governance record

- Source revision: `40-character commit SHA at PR head`
- Evidence / reports: `paths, commands, or primary-source links`
- Measurements or explicitly retained blockers: `state none, or list the unresolved inputs`
- Unresolved physical criteria: `yes` or `no`

Use `Closes #...` only when the linked issue's acceptance criteria are actually
satisfied. A PR declaring unresolved physical criteria must use `Refs #...`.

## Independent review

- Reviewer: `@non-author identity, or non-author agent identity`
- Reviewed final SHA: `40-character PR head SHA`
- Review result / warning rationale:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met with repository evidence
- [ ] ERC/DRC status recorded where applicable
- [ ] Component/cable mapping independently reviewed where applicable
- [ ] No unsupported manufacturing or radio-validation claim
